trials.instruction: Pick up the red and white beverage can using the right arm, drop it into the handheld basket, and lift the handheld basket with the other arm.
Pick up the can with flat silver bottom, place it in the rectangular basket with smooth surface, and then lift the rectangular basket with smooth surface.
Pick the red-orange text on white can with the left arm, set it in the basket for holding items, and lift the basket for holding items using another arm.
Grab and drop the red soda can with green accents in the carrying basket with black plastic handle, lift the carrying basket with black plastic handle.
Lift the smooth red can with silver bottom, place it inside the basket with perforated sides, and elevate the basket with perforated sides.
Grab the red drink can with white lid, put it in the brown basket with woven ridges, then raise the brown basket with woven ridges.
Pick the red and white beverage can, set it in the basket with handle, and lift the basket with handle upward.
Take the compact metal drink can, place it into the basket with loop handle, then lift the basket with loop handle.
Grab the metal can with printed white graphics, place it in the plastic basket, and raise the plastic basket using the other arm.
Place the small cylindrical drink container in the basket for carrying things and then lift the basket for carrying things.
